name: GPU-Based Chunk Culling via Indirect Commands
aliases: Compute Shader Frustum Culling with Indirect Draw
definition: A rendering optimization that uses a compute shader to filter visible chunks and generates indirect draw arguments on the GPU, reducing CPU-GPU synchronization overhead.
summary: GPU-Based Chunk Culling via Indirect Commands is a rendering optimization that uses a compute shader to filter visible chunks and generate indirect draw arguments on the GPU, reducing CPU-GPU synchronization overhead.
